work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af41_34_6"))
sql_af41_34_6 = """
SELECT  T1.MONEDA,
        T1.AÑO,
        T1.TRIM,
        34 AS SECTOR,
        '6' AS C_CAGENTE,
        T1.C_CUENTA,
        'D' AS C_ENTRADA,
        SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR = 34 THEN T1.DATO * -1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
        T1.C_SCN,
        T1.N_SCN,
        'PS' AS FUENTE,
        '0179a' AS PROC
INTO #af41_34_6
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI t1
WHERE (T1.C_ENTRADA = 'D' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.41' AND SECTOR = 34 AND C_CAGENTE = '6')
   OR (T1.C_ENTRADA = 'H' AND T1.C_SCN = 'AF.41' AND SECTOR = 6 AND C_CAGENTE = '34')
GROUP BY T1.MONEDA, T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_SCN, T1.N_SCN
"""
